cases.scenario: Damaged on arrival, low value, first refund, photo evidence

request.claim_text: The ceramic mug arrived in pieces. The box was crushed on one side and there is a photo of the damage attached to the ticket. I would like a refund for this order.

cases.scenario: Non-delivery, 21 days, tracking stalled, low value

request.claim_text: The tracking page has not moved for 21 days and the carrier says the parcel is delayed. The order never arrived and I still need it. Please refund me so I can order again.

cases.scenario: Change of mind, used item, past normal return window

request.claim_text: I bought these shoes last month and wore them twice. They are fine but I changed my mind and would prefer the money back. Can I return them?

cases.scenario: High-value custom item, not as described

request.claim_text: The custom sofa does not match the fabric sample I approved. The colour is much darker and the stitching is uneven. For this price I expected the agreed specification, so I want a full refund.

cases.scenario: Repeated refunds, tracking shows delivered, dispute threat

request.claim_text: This is my fourth refund request this month. The tracking says the parcel was delivered and signed for, but I never received it. I want the money back immediately or I will dispute the charge.

cases.scenario: Abusive language, no evidence, prior refunds

request.claim_text: I am not giving you any more details. You people are useless and I am not waiting any longer. Refund me now or I will keep complaining everywhere.
